name: Instructor's Request

start.dialog: I'm documenting Blue Magic spells for the Academy. The Prism creatures have some unique ones. Help me observe them? I'll need you to take hits so I can study the effects. Don't worry - I'll heal you.
start.objective: Let Prism creatures use their special attacks on you while Quistis observes

progress.dialog: Interesting! That laser absorption technique... and the crystal shard spray! Take notes! This is valuable data!
progress.objective: Survive more creature attacks for observation

complete.dialog: Excellent data! Three new Blue Magic spells documented! Here - the skill manual. Laser Eye, Ultra Waves, and Electrocute. Use them wisely!

party_comments.kade: Getting hit on purpose. For science. Sure.
party_comments.twist: Ouch! That looked like it hurt!
party_comments.nix7: Sacrificing bodily integrity for data. Acceptable trade-off.

hidden_outcome: If you survive all attacks without healing items (just Quistis's healing), she gives you 'Save the Queen' - her ultimate whip
